reviewItem.question: Does "loki Ruler: Fixed a panic that can be caused by concurrent read-write access of tenant configs when there are a large amount of rules" mean a change to protocol-behavior:loki|name=tenant-config-concurrent-access|component=ruler (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Loki Ruler no longer panics from concurrent read-write access of tenant configs when there are a large amount of rules.
